script.title: TWENTY PERCENT BACK
script.scene_zh: 車站櫃檯 · 申請誤點退款
script.story_hook: A late train earns a commuter some money back.
script.intro_zh: 一班誤點的列車，讓通勤族拿回了一筆錢。
script.welcome_en: Good morning! Today, claiming a refund for a delayed train.
script.welcome_zh: 早安！今天要學的，是為誤點列車申請退款。
script.outro: A small refund, a big mood fix. Safe tracks ahead!
script.outro_zh: 退款雖小，心情大好。願你前方的月臺一切準點！
script.practice_intro_en: Let's echo each line, nice and slow.
script.practice_intro_zh: 我們慢慢地、一句一句跟讀。
script.char_a_description: a slim man in his early thirties with short sandy hair and light stubble, a charcoal wool overcoat over a checked shirt, a gray scarf, a leather laptop bag, and a tired smile
script.char_b_description: a friendly woman in her mid forties with chin-length auburn hair, wire-frame glasses, a station-blue polo shirt with a name tag, a silver watch, and a practical build
script.char_b_role: ticket agent at the service window

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Morning. This counter handles delay claims?
dialogue.zh: 早安，這裡是受理誤點索賠的服務櫃檯嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Morning! Yes, delayed trains, refunds.
dialogue.zh: 早安！是的，誤點列車退款都找我們。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great, because the 8:05 really tested me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡreɪt bɪˈkɔz ðə eɪt əˈfɪɪɾər ˈɹɪli ˈtɛstɪd mi/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，因為8點05分那班真把我考倒了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh, which trouble? Delay or cancellation?
dialogue.zh: 喔，是哪種狀況？誤點還是停駛？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Forty minutes late. No update at all.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɔɹti ˈmɪnəts leɪt noʊ ˈʌpˌdeɪt ʔæt ɔl/
dialogue.zh: 遲到四十分鐘，半點消息都沒有。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ugh, that was a signal problem.
dialogue.zh: 呃，那是號誌故障造成的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I missed my connection, so…
dialogue.zh: 我因此錯過了轉乘，所以…

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So you deserve some money back.
dialogue.zh: 所以你確實該拿回一些錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's the plan. It's my weekly pass.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ðə plæn ɪs maɪ ˈwikli pæs/
dialogue.zh: 正合我意，用的是我的週票。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good news—weekly passes count.
dialogue.zh: 好消息，週票也在退款範圍內。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much do you give back?
dialogue.zh: 你們大概退多少呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twenty percent for delays over half an hour.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtwɛnti pɚˈsɛnt fɔɹ dɪˈleɪz ˈoʊvəɹ hæf ən ˈaʊəɹ/
dialogue.zh: 誤點超過半小時，退兩成。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twenty? That helps, actually.
dialogue.zh: 兩成？其實已經很有幫助了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Small but fair. Need your ticket number.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɔl bʌt fɛɹ nid jɔɹ ˈtɪkɪt ˈnʌmbəɹ/
dialogue.zh: 錢不多但公道，先給我票號。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sure… um, where did I put it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊɹ ʌm wɛɹ dɪd aɪ pʊt ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 好的…呃，我把它放到哪兒去了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take a breath, we have time.
dialogue.zh: 先深呼吸，我們來得及。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, it might be in my laptop bag.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ ɪt maɪt bi ɪn maɪ ˈlɑpˌtɑp bæɡ/
dialogue.zh: 好，可能在我的筆電包裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Or check the email confirmation.
dialogue.zh: 要不然就查那封確認信。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Email! Right, I bought it online.
dialogue.zh: 郵件！對喔，我是在線上買的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Even better. Search the word 'receipt'.
dialogue.zh: 那就更好了，搜尋收據兩個字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Found it! Six digits at the top.
dialogue.phonetic: /faʊnd ɪt sɪks ˈdɪdʒɪts ʔæt ðə tɑp/
dialogue.zh: 找到了！最上面有六個數字。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Read me the last four, please.
dialogue.zh: 請把最後四碼唸給我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Seven, two, nine, zero.
dialogue.zh: 七、二、九、零。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it, I'm typing it now.
dialogue.zh: 收到，我正在輸入。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need to show ID too?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ nid tə ʃoʊ ˈaɪˈdi tu/
dialogue.zh: 我還需要出示身分證嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not for twenty percent.
dialogue.zh: 退兩成不需要驗身分證。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, good. My ID photo is funny.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ɡʊd maɪ ˈaɪˌdi ˈfoʊtoʊ ɪz ˈfʌni/
dialogue.zh: 哈，那就好，我證件照長很好笑。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Photos always are. Now, how to pay you?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfoʊtoʊz ˈɔlweɪz ɑɹ naʊ haʊ tə peɪ ju/
dialogue.zh: 證件照都這樣。接著，錢怎麼給你？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cash? Please tell me cash is a choice.
dialogue.phonetic: /kæʃ pliːz tɛl mi kæʃ ɪz ə tʃɔɪs/
dialogue.zh: 現金？拜託告訴我，現金也是一個選項。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Well… I wish. Two real options.
dialogue.zh: 嗯…我倒希望，其實只有兩個選項。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hit me with them.
dialogue.zh: 那就說來聽聽吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Back on your card, or travel credit.
dialogue.phonetic: /bæk ɑn jɔɹ kɑɹd ɔɹ ˈtɹævəl ˈkɹɛdɪt/
dialogue.zh: 退回你的卡，或者是乘車儲值金。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Credit? What's travel credit like?
dialogue.zh: 儲值金？乘車儲值金是什麼用法？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It doubles—forty back on future trips.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ˈdʌbəlz ˈfɔɹti bæk ɑn ˈfjutʃɚ tɹɪps/
dialogue.zh: 額度直接翻倍，變成四成搭乘費。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, that's sneaky but nice.
dialogue.zh: 喔，這規定有點狡猾，但挺划算。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We try. Valid one full year.
dialogue.zh: 我們也盡力啦，有效期整整一年。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hmm. I take this train every week.
dialogue.phonetic: /hm aɪ teɪk ðɪs tɹeɪn ˈɛvɹi wiːk/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，我每週都搭這條線。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then credit fits you perfectly.
dialogue.zh: 那儲值金簡直是為你量身定做。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, small problem. My card's about to expire.
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt smɔl ˈpɑbləm maɪ kɑɹdz əˈbaʊt tə ɪkˈspaɪəɹ/
dialogue.zh: 等等，有個小麻煩，我的卡快到期了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ah, so refunds would take longer.
dialogue.zh: 啊，那樣退款就會拖比較久。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Right. Credit it is, then.
dialogue.zh: 沒錯，那就選儲值金吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great call. Sign this tiny screen.
dialogue.zh: 明智之舉，請在這小螢幕上簽名。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Like… scribble, or careful handwriting?
dialogue.zh: 要亂畫兩筆，還是一筆一劃？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Scribble is fine, truly.
dialogue.zh: 亂畫就好，真的沒關係。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Done. So when does the credit land?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn soʊ wɛn dʌz ðə ˈkɹɛdɪt lænd/
dialogue.zh: 簽好了，儲值金什麼時候會入帳？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two business days, maybe three.
dialogue.zh: 兩個工作天，也許三天。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fast enough. Do I get a code?
dialogue.phonetic: /fæst ɪˈnʌf du aɪ ɡɛt ə koʊd/
dialogue.zh: 夠快了，我會收到使用代碼嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's emailed automatically with a code.
dialogue.zh: 系統會自動發信，裡面附代碼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect. Anything else from me?
dialogue.zh: 完美，還有什麼要我補的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nope. Sorry about your Monday morning.
dialogue.zh: 沒有了，週一早上受累啦。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Honestly? Your smile fixed my morning.
dialogue.zh: 說真的，你一笑我整個早晨都修好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Aw, that's my job's best part.
dialogue.zh: 哎，這就是我工作最棒的時刻。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One last thing—where's platform nine?
dialogue.zh: 最後問一下，九號月臺往哪邊走？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Walk left, up the ramp, you're there.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɔk lɛf ʌp ðə ræmp jʊɹ ðɛɹ/
dialogue.zh: 往左走，上斜坡道就到了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great. I hope my train waits this time.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡreɪt aɪ hoʊp maɪ tɹeɪn weɪts ðɪs taɪm/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，希望這班車願意等等我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, don't jinx it, hurry along.
dialogue.zh: 哈，別說反話，快去吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks for the fair deal.
dialogue.zh: 謝謝你這麼公道地幫我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thanks for your patience. Safe travels!
dialogue.zh: 謝謝你的耐心，旅途平安！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: See you next Monday, probably.
dialogue.zh: 下週一應該又會見面了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll keep the twenty percent warm!
dialogue.zh: 我會幫你留好那兩成退款！

script.youtube_description_en:
Forty minutes late — can you get money back? This 60-line American English listening scene walks the full refund path at a train station 🚉

A commuter explains the delay and the missed connection. The ticket agent checks the weekly pass, hunts down a receipt number, and lays out two refund paths: back to the card, or double travel credit. Along the way there is a missing email, an expiring card, and a signature pad. Every sentence is reusable at your own service window.

You will hear:
- Setting the scene: Forty minutes late. No update at all.
- Choosing a refund: Back on your card, or travel credit.
- Finding the number: Search the word 'receipt'.
- Easy signing: Scribble is fine, truly.

The second half is line-by-line listening plus shadowing 🎧, sentences under 10 words with connected-speech IPA, made for A2 learners.

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
